1) Do you support monthly invoicing (company PO) for hosted API usage, or is the product charged only to a credit card on file?
2) If you do invoice, what are the standard net terms and what paperwork does procurement need (W-9, tax forms, proof of SOC2, etc.)?

Thanks — want to get procurement a recommendation tomorrow.

Hi Olivia — great to hear the pilot is moving forward. Short answers up front: we support both card-on-file and monthly invoicing; Net30 is our default for invoiced customers.

More detail:
- Card (auto-charge): immediate provisioning, no PO required, best for < $5k/mo volume or teams that prefer self-serve.
- Monthly invoice (Net30): invoicing in arrears, invoices issued on the 1st business day of the month for prior-month usage. We typically require a PO number and a signed billing addendum for first-time invoiced customers.
- Larger customers can request Net45/Net60 but that requires approval from Finance and a committed-spend agreement.

Procurement paperwork: W-9 (for US entities), completed billing contact form, and our SOC2 report can be shared via our secure link. For EU billing to Acme Analytics GmbH we can route invoices to the EU entity — we’ll need VAT registration and the billing legal name/PO info.

I attached the current rate card to this note so you have baseline per-token/per-embedding pricing for hosted API. If you expect ~ $6k–$12k/month that's fine for standard hosted pricing; if you expect to convert to reserved capacity later we can run committed discount scenarios.

Attachment: redwood_rate_card_v2.pdf (pdf)

Next step: Who should I loop in on your procurement side (AP email + PO contact)? If you can share a sample PO cadence (e.g., monthly PO vs single PO for pilot) we can outline the exact invoice fields your AP needs.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Procurement team — Ben here (Senior Sales). Quick clarifications on discounts and invoicing logistics: 

- Discounting: For hosted API (usage-based) we typically offer a small volume tier discount for predictable monthly usage and deeper discounts for committed spend (e.g., 10% off list for a 12-month commitment at $200k+ total). For a pilot sized at $6k–$12k/mo we can discuss a pilot credit or a modest 5% commitment discount if Acme is willing to commit to a 6-month minimum spend floor.

- Invoice cadence: We invoice monthly in arrears with line-level usage; invoices are generated and delivered via email (PDF) and can be routed to your AP inbox or uploaded to SFTP if you prefer. Invoices include charge-date, SKU (generation/embedding/rerank), usage units, and total.

- Minimum invoice: no hard minimum, but for low-dollar months (< $500) Finance may request card-on-file or aggregate the charge into the next invoice — we can make an exception for pilot workflows.

- EU billing & VAT: We can bill your EU entity directly; please send legal entity name, VAT ID, and billing address. VAT treatment will follow the invoiced entity and local tax law.

Next steps: If AP can share a sample PO (PDF) and confirm AP email (ap@acmeanalytics.com), we'll open a billing ticket and have Finance generate the first invoice schedule + billing addendum. I'll also send a short commercial proposal that outlines the pilot discount options.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Remit to: Redwood Inference, 125 Market St, Suite 700, San Francisco, CA 94105
